title: Rope Routine
reference: F1 F1 F1 def F1 { tally_up repeat tally { forward } turn_left }
hints: Every stretch is the same routine. Only the tally changes.
Teach F1 to count, walk the tally and turn left. Call it three times.
F1 F1 F1 def F1 { tally_up repeat tally { forward } turn_left }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Ropewalk. The rope bots here run one routine all day. Teach it once. The tally changes how far it goes."
